summary: Frontend-only Expo prototype tested end-to-end via mobile web preview (375x667/390x844). Full 'Avec ce que j'ai' interactive flow validated: Home → Input → Consolidation → Confirmation → Meal choice → Compatibility → Recipe → Stock update → Pantry. All 3 compatibility scenarios (italian/2p/1r/none, asian/none, italian/2r/none) produce the exact expected messages and button labels. Static tabs (Meals, Tracking, Profile) render without errors. Reset demo restores initial values. No crashes, no red screens, no cut text.

issues: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated on web (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' — cosmetic React Native Web deprecation warnings only, no functional impact.

action_items: OPTIONAL: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN web warnings.
OPTIONAL: expose a data-testid on the weekly chart card (e.g. card-week) for future automation — not required by spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Consolidation Continuer button reuses testID 'btn-continue-confirm' (which is semantically the button that leads TO confirmation — acceptable but slightly ambiguous with confirmation.tsx's own 'btn-continue-meal-choice'). Both work correctly; consider renaming consolidation testID to 'btn-continue-consolidation' for clarity.
All screens use proper React Native components (View/Text/TouchableOpacity), StyleSheet.create, and testIDs. No raw HTML tags detected.
seed_data_creation: None — in-memory MenooProvider context with mockData.ts. Reset demo verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home path '/' redirects via app/index.tsx → /(tabs) → (tabs)/index.tsx which shows the 3 cards. Testable via [data-testid=path-with-what-i-have]. Full flow testIDs: btn-validate-input, source-off/op/menoo, btn-continue-confirm (consolidation), slider-{pates,champignons,creme}, btn-continue-meal-choice, people-{inc,dec,value}, meals-{inc,dec,value}, cuisine-{italienne,asiatique,mediterraneenne,...}, rule-{none,one_or_two,...}, btn-check-compat, gauge-{pates,champignons,creme}, btn-see-recipe (label toggles between 'Voir la recette' and 'Ajuster les choix'), btn-cooked, btn-see-other, btn-back-pantry, btn-reset-demo. Note: React Native Slider drag via Playwright mouse events does not reliably move the thumb — verify slider VALUES via UI text (e.g. '250 g disponibles sur 500 g') rather than drag simulation.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Prototype meets all functional and design requirements listed in the review request.
